name: eep-monorepo
description: Entity Engagement Protocol — monorepo root. See README.md for an overview and packages/@eep-dev/* for the published artifacts.
//workspaces: Workspace topology is declared in pnpm-workspace.yaml. We deliberately do NOT add an `npm` `workspaces` field here, because doing so makes npm v9+ treat each child package as a workspace member and expect a unified lockfile at this root, which breaks every per-package `npm ci` in CI (we ship per-package package-lock.json files).

scripts.test:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:python
